g.text: BC-04 Sales Commitment — Tactical Domain Model (TARGET / V1)
+canCommit(request: PurchaseRequest, backing: BackingDecision, credit: CreditDecision): boolean
PR -> Commitment -> SO ownership transfer has no release/re-reserve gap.
Direct Order -> Commitment(origin=DIRECT_ORDER) -> SO uses the same boundary;
no synthetic PurchaseRequest and no polymorphic FK.
BC-05 backing and BC-07 credit are stable decision references, not compositions.
